description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git functionalities, specifically around line ending normalization, merge conflicts, and related behaviors. It sets up test repositories, configurations, and various test scenarios involving text=auto, CRLF/LF conflicts, and renormalization scenarios.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming CR and NULL characters into a placeholder using tr, then verifies they are identical.

methods.name: fuzz_conflict
methods.description: Generates a fuzzy conflict marker by sed replacement to simulate conflict resolving output for testing.
